description:
The Kingdom of Kaldex succeeds in bringing down its neighboring nation, the Kingdom of Ersoil. The last surviving prince, Kanol, escapes, and the Oil Ducal House, celebrated for its role in Ersoil’s fall, now lives each day in fear of revenge. One day, a suspicious maid named Diesel enters the ducal household. The innocent heir, Olive, is instantly smitten by Diesel’s radiant beauty and imposing physique. But then…

*“Diesel… what is that… between your legs?!”*

**Original Webtoon**  
[Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/etv), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/etv)
